observations.title: DOCN Buy and Hold Strategy · Argus
observations.quick_take: This backtest shows a buy-and-hold strategy for DigitalOcean (DOCN) from September 2023 through September 2026, which grew a $1,000 starting capital to a total return of 396.26%. That outperformed the SPY benchmark by 327.27 percentage points over the same period, though the ride was rough with a maximum drawdown of 44.86%. The strategy executed only one trade during this window, meaning the entire result comes from holding the position through a single entry and exit.
observations.breakdown:
Buy and Hold for DOCN, Sep 1, 2023 → Sep 9, 2026. The total return was +396.3%. It finished 327.3 percentage points ahead of SPY. The worst drop was -44.9%.

SPY returned +69.0% over the tested period.

This is a historical simulation, not a forecast or investment advice.
